title: Arbitrage Research
readme: Research and paper delivery first. M0–M5 establish correctness and economic evidence. M6–M7 are optional and require reviewed live-specific gates; a ticket being planned does not authorize funding or signing. Repository source: planning/backlog.json. Keep the project status aligned with reviewed evidence, and retain closed issues for traceability.
rules: All imported M0–M5 issues start in Backlog; M6–M7 start Deferred.
Ready requires prerequisites complete and scope accepted by the accountable role.
Done requires acceptance criteria and linked verification; the bootstrap never closes issues.
The built-in Status field is retained; Delivery status is the canonical workflow field.
Bootstrap only initializes new project items; existing operator status values are retained on reruns.
No assignees, calendar dates, purchases, live enablement or automatic promotion are invented.

Initialize absent Role, Release gate and Dependency IDs fields on existing items; preserve every existing operator field value, including empty text. Reject incompatible field types or unavailable select options before field-value writes.
view_creation_notes: The views component creates missing named native views using the current REST API, and preserves existing views. User-owned view REST endpoints require OAuth/classic authentication; GitHub App tokens and fine-grained PATs are not supported by those endpoints. The project source does not claim publication until that remote phase completes.

metadata_mapping.Role: First role listed in the canonical responsible-role string. Full collaborating roles remain in the issue body. This is a role label, not a person assignment.
metadata_mapping.Release gate: Tasks use their canonical release_gate code; epics use their milestone exit-gate label. Full criteria remain in the canonical issue body.
metadata_mapping.Dependency IDs: Comma-separated stable prerequisite IDs, or None. Native blocked-by relationships remain authoritative; this is a display field.
